Inside Our Rooms Ndani ya Vyumba Vyetu

Modern comfort
built in. Starehe ya kisasa
ndani ya chumba.

Every room at Kas Classic Hotel is thoughtfully furnished with modern conveniences—from climate control and a digital safe to a mini-fridge, electric tea kettle, and private hot shower. Kila chumba katika Kas Classic Hotel kimewekewa vifaa vya kisasa—kuanzia kiyoyozi (AC), kasiki ya kidijitali (safe), friji ndogo, birika la chai hadi bafu lenye maji ya moto.

On-Site Facilities Huduma Zilizopo Hotelini

Hot pool, gym, dining
& everyday convenience. Bwawa la maji ya moto, gym
na huduma zote muhimu.

Everything on our Makambako compound is designed so you can swim, work out, dine, bank, and relax without leaving the hotel. Huduma zote zipo ndani ya eneo moja—kuanzia bwawa la maji ya moto, Gym, mgahawa, juisi hadi Mini Bank na maegesho salama.

Heated Pool Maji ya Moto

Hot Swimming Pool & Sunken Lounge Bwawa la Maji ya Moto & Mapumziko

Enjoy a warm swim even in Makambako's cool highland weather, complete with sunken poolside white sofas, sun loungers, and evening LED lighting. Furahia kuogelea kwenye maji ya moto hata wakati wa baridi ya Makambako, pamoja na masofa ya kisasa kando ya bwawa na taa za usiku.

Dining & Drinks Chakula na Vinywaji

Restaurant, Nyama Choma & Juice Bar Mgahawa, Nyama Choma & Banda la Juisi

Freshly grilled Kuku & Nyama Choma, Sato fish, Mchemsho, and a dedicated two-story bamboo Fruit Juice pavilion serving fresh tropical blends. Kuku na Nyama Choma, Samaki Sato, Mchemsho pamoja na banda maalum la ghorofa la juisi halisi za matunda.

Fitness & Wellness Mazoezi na Afya

Upper-Level Fitness Gym Gym ya Kisasa ya Mazoezi

Stay active during your trip at our panoramic glass-enclosed upper-level Gym overlooking the hotel courtyard and Makambako town. Fanya mazoezi ukiwa safarini kwenye Gym yetu ya kisasa iliyopo ghorofani yenye mandhari nzuri ya mji wa Makambako.

Guest Convenience Huduma Muhimu Hapa Hapa

On-Site Mini Bank, Mini Shop & Parking Mini Bank, Mini Shop na Maegesho

Access banking/mobile money services (Mini Bank), travel essentials (Mini Shop), and spacious cabro-paved courtyard parking right inside the hotel. Pata huduma za kifedha (Mini Bank), mahitaji muhimu (Mini Shop) na maegesho makubwa na salama ya magari ndani ya fensi ya hoteli.
